name: Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3
purpose: Multilingual (25 European languages) high-throughput ASR with punctuation, capitalization and word timestamps; automatic language detection (card).

license.name: CC-BY-4.0
license.notes: HF tag cc-by-4.0, no LICENSE file in the repo. CC BY 4.0 legal code read (Fluid Speech Pro repo LICENSE, same license); commercial use and redistribution allowed with attribution.

architecture.kind: NON-AUTOREGRESSIVE FastConformer encoder + TDT transducer decoder (no LLM; compute-bound encoder, Tona's decode machinery does not apply)

engine_support.notes: transcribe.cpp README lists HIP/ROCm (research/52 said Vulkan only: update it). Windowed local attention [256,256] gives linear memory: a 25 min talk on a 16 GB laptop.

benchmarks.name: TED-LIUM 3 full talks WER, full attention to windowed
Long-form mean WER (55 min chunks)
benchmarks.harness: NVIDIA's table on the Nemotron Transcribe card

benchmarks.name: German WER, Open ASR multilingual track (6 of 8 datasets)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, German column (WER %), read from the Space config JSON 2026-11-19; rows differ in how many of the 8 datasets they cover

benchmarks.name: Open ASR English avg WER (leaderboard rank 39 of 69)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard English track, read 2026-11-19

benchmarks.name: RTFx on the leaderboard (English track, leaderboard GPU)
German average WER in the leaderboard paper (Table 4)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, paper snapshot (late 2025); whisper-large-v3 4.97, canary-1b-v2 4.96, Voxtral Mini 3B 5.36

strengths: Tiny (0.74 GB Q8), CPU-feasible, thousands of x real time on GPU
Word timestamps; 24 min full attention or 3 h local attention
weaknesses: Words missing from the vocabulary rarely recognized; isolated words poor
best_for: Dictation and batch transcription, German via the primeline fine-tune
soft.maturity: NVIDIA; 1288 likes, 527k downloads; ported to many runtimes.

user_reports.summary: Sometimes drops whole sentences in clean audio (offline and streaming, NeMo and ONNX); a second user sees the same in July.
Without an explicit language tag the model hallucinates words from other European languages (no language forcing in the API).

tona_fit.reason: Fast (RTFx 6322), small, CC-BY-4.0, every class; German 4.12 on the independent leaderboard is behind newer models (Cohere 3.10, Qwen3-ASR 3.88, Fluid 3.76) but it has the mature GGML path (transcribe.cpp incl. HIP). Known: dropped sentences, language hallucination without a tag. Run as managed side engine.

sources.note: Open ASR Leaderboard paper; read through the fetch tool summarizer

open_questions: Own RTF on gfx1200 via transcribe.cpp ROCm (unmeasured)
